seraphine.title: Lady
seraphine.name: Seraphine Rosenhal
seraphine.backstory: The last of the Rosenhals: no money, a title worth nothing, and a castle that now belongs to a commoner in a hoodie. She knows every noble in the kingdom and exactly how to host them. Hosting is the only pride her family has left, and she intends to be magnificent at it.

design.hairStyle: long golden hair in an old-fashioned updo
design.features: a family signet ring she never takes off

sig_seraphine.label: Faded court silks
sig_seraphine.prompt: an old-fashioned but immaculate gold-embroidered court dress, slightly faded

sp_seraphine.label: Rosenhal ball gown
sp_seraphine.prompt: a breathtaking crimson ball gown with the Rosenhal rose crest

unique.name: Noble Hostess
unique.desc: She knows exactly how to charm nobility.

ilyana.title: Lady
ilyana.name: Ilyana Silverbough
ilyana.backstory: The Pavilion's elven patroness for a century. She decided she would rather be part of it than own it from afar. She funded its first stage out of boredom and kept it out of affection, and now wants to know how it feels from the other side of the curtain.

design.accessories: tiny pearls woven into her hair
design.expression: a serene smile that misses nothing

sig_ilyana.label: Patroness robes
sig_ilyana.prompt: layered silver-grey elven robes with moon-lily embroidery

sp_ilyana.label: Moonsilk gown
sp_ilyana.prompt: a gown of shimmering moonsilk that is more light than fabric

sylphine.note: The Pavilion's patroness has watched Sylphine dance for decades.

unique.name: Century of Poise
unique.desc: A hundred years of patronage give her unshakable poise.

ines.name: Ines Varga
ines.backstory: A former ghost hunter who came to exorcise Hollowmere Manor and stayed to make amends. She still sleeps with a silver dagger under her pillow, out of habit. On her first night Vesper offered her tea instead of fleeing, and she has never quite recovered; she now considers the manor her responsibility.

design.features: a thin scar along her jaw

sig_ines.label: Ghost-hunter's coat
sig_ines.prompt: a long black hunter's coat with silver buckles and a bandolier of charms

sp_ines.label: Duelist's outfit
sp_ines.prompt: a silver-trimmed duelist's jacket, white shirt and tall boots

vesper.note: She came to exorcise Vesper. Vesper has not forgotten.

unique.name: Ghost Hunter's Eye
unique.desc: She notices danger before anyone else does.

vharra.name: Vharra
vharra.backstory: The Underdistrict's landlord, until she got bored of collecting rent and decided it would be more fun to make it. She owns half the lanes down there and the other half owe her favors. She treats Sam's debts as a game, and keeps score for fun.

design.accessories: heavy gold horn rings and piercings

sig_vharra.label: Landlord's silks
sig_vharra.prompt: draped emerald silks with heavy gold chains and rings

sp_vharra.label: Underdistrict regalia
sp_vharra.prompt: black and emerald infernal regalia with a jeweled collar

unique.name: Landlord's Cut
unique.desc: She always takes a little more from every deal, and nobody minds.

rhoswen.name: Rhoswen
rhoswen.backstory: A noble elf who walked away from a stifling court to see how humans actually live. Curious, very proper, and quietly thrilled to be somewhere scandalous. She carries a leather notebook of observations, blushes at her own boldness, and has never been so happy to be called "miss" instead of "my lady."

sig_rhoswen.label: Court gown
sig_rhoswen.prompt: a flowing pale-green silk court gown

hanna.name: Hanna Weiss
hanna.backstory: The Adventurers' Guild's most efficient receptionist and its biggest gossip. She's been dying for an excuse to see the inside of a pleasure house. She knows every adventurer's tab and secret crush by heart, and has been quietly cataloguing which of them visit the Lantern.

sig_hanna.label: Guild uniform
sig_hanna.prompt: a neat guild uniform with a short blue cape

kaede.note: Hanna processed every one of Kaede's bounty claims, and gossiped about all of them.

unique.name: Guild Gossip
unique.desc: She knows everyone's business, and tells enough of it to bring customers in.
